methodologyNotes: Ten models researched and independently re-verified: Husqvarna Automower 450X, 430X, 415X; Segway Navimow i105 and X3 (X315 representative); Mammotion Luba 2 AWD 5000 and Yuka 1500; Worx Landroid Vision (WR208); EcoFlow Blade; Ecovacs Goat G1. Sources: manufacturer pages (husqvarna.com, navimow.com, support.mammotion.com, worx.com/eu.worx.com, eu.ecoflow.com, ecovacs.com), major US retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Lowes, Home Depot, Best Buy), and editorial reviews (NotebookCheck, lawncareguides.com, protoolreviews.com). Adversarial re-check (2026-06-16/17) corrected: Navimow X315 max_area_m2 2000->1500; Luba 2 AWD 5000 priceUsd 2999->2899; Worx WR208 source/corroboration URLs (draft pointed at WR206E/M600 EU page + a headlight accessory page -> now official US WR208 page + EU WR208E/M800 spec page). max_area_m2 = manufacturer-stated max working area; max_slope_pct = steepest gradient rated for the main mowing area; cutting_width_mm = blade disc sweep; booleans true only when confirmed by manufacturer text or reputable review, null where neither confirmed nor denied. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Husqvarna Automower 450X
products.priceNote: Approximate street price; still listed by dealers/retailers at ~$3,299-$3,499. EPOS wire-free variant is a separate SKU.
products.provenance: Husqvarna US product page confirms 1.25 acres (~5060 m2), 45% (24deg) max slope, 9.45 in (240 mm) cutting width, and GPS theft tracking. Launched 2016. Cutting height 20-60 mm (some sources cite 20-61 mm). Rain/weather-adaptive operation confirmed by EasyLawnMowing review. Price ~$3000 is an approximate figure; current dealer retail runs ~$3,299-$3,499.

products.name: Husqvarna Automower 430X
products.priceNote: Approximate last-seen street price (~$1,999-$2,250); X-line successor is the 430X NERA.
products.provenance: Husqvarna confirms 0.8 acres (~3240 m2), 45% slope, 9.45 in (240 mm) cutting width, GPS theft tracking via Automower Connect, launched 2016. Cutting height 0.8-2.4 in (~20-61 mm) per Lowes/AllMachines. Rain/weather-adaptive operation confirmed by multiple reviews. Price ~$2000 per retailer history (Lowes/aggregators).

products.name: Husqvarna Automower 415X
products.provenance: Husqvarna US page confirms 0.37 acre (~1500 m2), 40% slope inside installation (15% at boundary), 8.7 in (220 mm) cutting width, GPS theft tracking + PIN. MSRP $1,999.99 confirmed by lawncareguides.com. Cutting height 20-50 mm per lawncareguides/AllMachines. Rain sensor neither confirmed nor denied by manufacturer page -> null.

products.name: Segway Navimow i105
products.priceNote: navimow.com US store price; list/regular price ~$949.
products.provenance: Price $799 on navimow.com US store. Coverage 500 m2 (0.125 acre), cutting width 180 mm (7.1 in), cutting height 20-60 mm, 30% slope per official i-Series pages and reviews. Rain sensor and anti-theft (Navimow Access+/alarm) confirmed by i-Series documentation.

products.name: Segway Navimow X3 (X315)
products.priceNote: X315 US price on navimow.com (marketed as 0.5 acre); larger X3 SKUs priced higher.
products.provenance: X315 price $1999 confirmed on navimow.com US store. Max working area corrected to 1500 m2 (navimowuk.com spec table + protoolreviews.com; US page's '0.5 acre' is marketing copy). Max slope 50% (27deg) confirmed. Cutting width 23.7 cm (237 mm), cutting height 20-70 mm. EFLS 3.0 (RTK + vSLAM + VIO) navigation. Rain-adaptive and GPS+alarm anti-theft confirmed. US launch April 2025.

products.name: Mammotion Luba 2 AWD 5000
products.priceNote: Standard (1.0"-2.7" cut height) variant price on Mammotion/Amazon/Wellbots; H variant differs.
products.provenance: Mammotion support spec page confirms 5000 m2 working area, 400 mm dual cutting disc, cutting height 25-70 mm (standard) / 55-100 mm (H), rain sensor. Max slope: AWD marketed and listed by Amazon/Best Buy at 80% (38deg) for the all-wheel-drive model; the support doc's '45%(24deg)' is a conservative/legacy figure, so 80% retained as the headline AWD rating. Price corrected 2999->2899 (Mammotion direct + Amazon). Anti-theft (GPS, geofence alarm, AirTag support, PIN) confirmed by reviews. UltraSense AI Vision + RTK navigation.

products.name: Mammotion Yuka 1500
products.priceNote: Original MSRP; line superseded by Yuka 2000/3000 and frequently discounted to ~$1,399 (solo). Sweeper combo costs more.
products.provenance: Amazon/Walmart listings confirm 0.37 acre reception (max 0.44 acre, ~1500 m2 nominal), 45% (24deg) slope, cut height 1.2"-4.0" (~30-100 mm), RTK + 3D Vision navigation. Cutting width 12.59 in (320 mm). MSRP $1599 (solo); commonly discounted to ~$1399 and the 1500 is now overlapped by cheaper Yuka 2000/3000 SKUs. Rain sensor confirmed by reviews. Anti-theft not positively confirmed for this SKU -> null. 2024 version.

products.name: Worx Landroid Vision (WR208)
products.priceNote: Original MSRP $1,599.99; frequently on sale to ~$799.99 in 2025-2026 clearance.
products.provenance: WR208 is the 1/5-acre US variant (8,712 sq ft ~ 800 m2). Source/corroboration URLs corrected: draft pointed at the EU WR206E/M600 page and a headlight-accessory page; the correct EU equivalent is WR208E (M800), which confirms 800 m2, 30% max slope, 19 cm (190 mm) cutting width, 30-60 mm cutting height, rain sensor, and anti-theft (Find My Landroid module). Original MSRP $1,599.99 with frequent ~$799.99 sale pricing. Pure AI-camera vision navigation, no boundary wire/RTK/LiDAR.

products.name: EcoFlow Blade
products.priceNote: MSRP mower-only; Lawn Sweeper Kit bundle costs more.
products.provenance: Confirmed: 3000 m2 max area, ~50% (27deg) max slope, 260 mm cutting width, 20-76 mm cutting height, X-Vision (LiDAR + camera + RTK GPS) navigation. Price $2899 (mower only) per EcoFlow listings and Amazon. Rain sensor (auto return) confirmed. Anti-theft: auto-lock + 4G/GPS/eSIM per Amazon listing. Debuted 2023.

products.name: Ecovacs Goat G1
products.priceNote: G1-2000 (flagship) price per NotebookCheck hands-on (EUR1,999 / US$2,149); smaller G1-800/G1-1600 priced lower.
products.provenance: ECOVACS Goat G1 uses TrueMapping (UWB beacons + vision + GPS), 220 mm cutting width, 30-60 mm cutting height, 45% (24deg) max slope (the '50%/27deg' figure applies to the newer generic GOAT line, not the G1). Representative price uses the G1-2000 flagship at US$2,149 per NotebookCheck; G1-800/G1-1600 are cheaper. Rain sensor and anti-theft (4-digit PIN + alarm + GPS) confirmed by NextPit/TechReviewer. G1-1600 launched 2023; larger variants followed.
